n-k-l1b-02.title: Hana anotora bhazi ripi nhasi?
n-k-l1b-02.topic: Hangul muhupenyu chaihwo: bhodhi rechiteshi chebhazi
n-k-l1b-02.goal: Sarudza zvikamu zveruzivo zviri pabhodhi rebhazi nemumeseji zvinodikanwa kutumidza bhazi rakarurama, cherekedza mamiriro akanyorwa mumabhureketi, uye utsanangure sarudzo yako.
n-k-l1b-02.material:
Iwe neshamwari yako Hana muri pachiteshi chebhazi chinonzi 시장 앞. Mazuva: 월 Mon, 화 Tue, 수 Wed, 목 Thu, 금 Fri, 토 Sat, 일 Sun. 매일 = zuva rimwe nerimwe.

n-k-l1b-02.s.s1.r.b: Watoti kuchiteshi. Bhodhi rakafanana zita ripi zvaro, saka zita rechiteshi harisarudzi bhazi.
n-k-l1b-02.s.s1.r.e: Mutengo hauchinji kuti bhazi ripi rinoenda kunzvimbo iyoyo, uye bhodhi harioneshi mutengo.

n-k-l1c-01.title: Ndiani anodzidzisa ani mufananidzo?
n-k-l1c-01.topic: Nyaya, chinhu nemaparticle: ndiani anoita chii
n-k-l1c-01.goal: Sarudza mazwi api anokodzera mufananidzo, edza chinongedzo chako nemazwi matsva, uye utsanangure kuti nei mazwi anoita sezvakafanana anoreva zvinopesana.
n-k-l1c-01.material: Nyaya yekirasi ine mufananidzo: 수진 ari kudzidzisa 민수 kudhirowa. Vadzidzi vashanu vanokurudzira mazwi. Mazwi: 가르쳐요 = anodzidzisa. Maparticle: 이/가 anotevera anoita chimwe chinhu; 은/는 anotevera musoro ("as for ..."); 을/를 anotevera anoitirwa chiito.
n-k-l1c-01.thinking.2: Kutsanangurira munhu anofunga nenhevedzano yemazwi echiRungu mutemo
n-k-l1c-01.prereq.1: Wakasangana ne 이/가 ne 을/를 (muiti nemugamuchiri)
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.prompt: Mumufananidzo, 수진 ari kudzidzisa 민수. Mazwi api anotsanangura mufananidzo uyu? Sarudza ese anoshanda.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.hint.0: Usaverenge mazita kubva kuruboshwe kuenda kurudyi. Tanga watsvaga zita rine 이/가 kana 은/는 uye rine 을/를.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bvunza pamutsara mumwe nemumwe: ndiani ane 를 (kana 을) shure kwezita, uye munhu iyeye anodzidziswa here kana kudzidzisa?
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.r.b: Particle 가 iri pa 민수, saka 민수 ndiye anodzidzisa pano. Izvo zvinopesana nemufananidzo.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.r.d: 수진 anotanga, asi 을 iri pa 수진: ndiye anodzidziswa uye 민수 anodzidzisa. Nhevedzano yemazwi haisi chinongedzo.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s1.explain: Mu a, c ne e, 수진 ane 이/가 kana 은/는 (anoita kana musoro) uye 민수 ane 를 (anodzidziswa). Nhevedzano yemazita maviri inogona kuchinja; maparticle anochengeta mabasa.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.prompt: Mazwi matsva anoonekwa: 동생을 엄마가 안아요. (안아요 = anokumbatira, 엄마 = amai, 동생 = munin'ina/mununʼgina.) Ndiani anokumbatira ani?
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga particle shure kwezita rimwe nerimwe usati waverenga nhevedzano.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bvunza kuti particle ipi inoratidza anoita chiito uye ipi inoratidza anochigamuchira.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.o.a: 엄마 anokumbatira 동생, nokuti 엄마 ine 가 uye 동생 ine 을.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.o.b: 동생 anokumbatira 엄마, nokuti 동생 ndiro zita rekutanga mumutsara.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.r.b: Zita rekutanga haritanga ririye anoita. 동생 ine 을, saka 동생 ndiye anokumbatirwa.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.o.c: Vanokumbatirana, nokuti mazita ese ane particle.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.r.c: Maparticle akasiyana. 가 inoratidza anokumbatira uye 을 inoratidza anokumbatirwa.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.o.d: Hatigoni kuziva, nokuti mazita ari munhevedzano isina kujairika.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.r.d: Unogona kuziva: maparticle anochengeta mabasa kunyange nhevedzano ichichinja.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s2.explain: 가 iri pa 엄마 (anokumbatira) uye 을 iri pa 동생 (anokumbatirwa), saka mazwi acho anoreva kuti amai vanokumbatira munin'ina wavo. Maparticle, kwete nhevedzano, ndiwo anopa mabasa.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.prompt: Shamwari inoverenga nhevedzano yemazwi echiRungu uye inoti: "수진을 민수가 가르쳐요 starts with 수진, so 수진 teaches." Mumutsara mumwe kana miviri yechiRungu, tsanangura kuti nei mazwi aya asingaenderani nemufananidzo.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.hint.0: Nongedzera particle iri padyo ne 수진 neiri padyo ne 민수.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.hint.1: Taura kuti particle imwe neimwe inokuudza basa rei rezita rayo.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakataura particle iri pa 수진 here?
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakataura kuti ndiani anodzidzisa mumazwi aya here?
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.model.0: 수진 ine particle 을, saka ndiye anodzidziswa; 민수 ine 가, saka 민수 anodzidzisa. Nzvimbo haisarudze.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.model.1: Maparticle anoratidza mabasa, kwete nhevedzano: 을 inoratidza 수진 semugamuchiri uye 가 inoratidza 민수 semuiti, saka inoti 민수 anodzidzisa 수진.
n-k-l1c-01.s.s3.model.2: Nokuti 가 inoratidza kuti 민수 ndiye anodzidzisa.

n-k-l1c-02.title: 민호 anoitei kupi? Kutarisa dhayari
n-k-l1c-02.topic: Maparticle enzvimbo: 에 (enda, ve) vs 에서 (ita)
n-k-l1c-02.goal: Tsvaga mitsara mudhayari pfupi umo particle yenzvimbo isina kururama yashandiswa, taura mutemo unopatsanura 에 ne 에서, uye ugadzirise mitsara.
n-k-l1c-02.material: Mudzidzi, 민호, anonyora zuva rake muchiKorea. Mamwe maparticle enzvimbo haana kururama. Mazwi: 아침 = mangwanani, 점심 = masikati, 오후 = masikati ekupedzisira, 저녁 = manheru, 운동해요 = anoita zvekurovedza muviri.
n-k-l1c-02.thinking.0: Kuona kukanganisa nekutarisa mutsara mumwe nemumwe nemutemo
n-k-l1c-02.prereq.1: Unoziva kuti 에 ne 에서 zvinovapo (maparticle enzvimbo)
n-k-l1c-02.s.s1.prompt: Iyi dhayari ya민호 nezvezuva rimwe. Mimwe mitsara ine kukanganisa kweparticle yenzvimbo (iripo yakawanda). Sarudza mutsara upi zvawo une iko.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s1.hint.0: Isa mutsetse pazasi pechiito neparticle yenzvimbo mumutsara mumwe nemumwe. Mitsara ipi inoita sezvakafanana?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s1.hint.1: Pidigura mitsara kuita mapoka nechiito chayo, wobva waona kuti boka rimwe nerimwe rinoshandisa particle ipi.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s1.explain: Mitsara 3, 5 ne 7 haina kururama: 도서관에서 책을 읽어요 (chiito panzvimbo), 집에 있어요 (kuvapo panzvimbo), 공원에서 운동해요 (chiito panzvimbo). Mitsara 1, 2, 4 ne 6 yakanaka.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.prompt: Mutemo upi unotsanangura musiyano pakati pe 에 ne 에서 mudhayari iyi?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.hint.0: Boka mitsara yakarurama nezviito zvayo: zviito zvipi zvinoenda ne 에 uye zvipi ne 에서?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.hint.1: Bvunza: chiito chinoti munhu anofamba kana kuramba, kana munhu anoita chimwe chinhu ipapo?
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.o.a: 에 inoratidza nzvimbo umo chiito chinoitika; 에서 inoratidza nzvimbo yaunoenda kana yauri.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.r.a: Izvo zvakadzoserwa. Tarisa 학교에 가요 (enda ku) ne 식당에서 먹어요 (dya pa).
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.o.b: 에 ndeyenzvimbo huru senge chikoro; 에서 ndeyenzvimbo diki senge kamuri.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.r.b: Hukuru hahuna basa: 학교에서 ne 집에서 zvose zvakanaka kuchiito.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.o.c: 에 ne 에서 zvinoreva chinhu chimwe chete; chero ipi inoshanda nechiito chipi nechipi.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.r.c: Zvakasiyana: 도서관에 책을 읽어요 inonzwika zvakaipa kuvaKorea.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.o.d: 에서 inoratidza nzvimbo umo chiito chinoitika; 에 inoratidza nzvimbo yaunoenda kana yauri.
n-k-l1c-02.s.s2.explain: 에서 = nzvimbo yaunoita chimwe chinhu (kudya, kuverenga, kudzidza, kurovedza muviri). 에 = nzvimbo yaunoenda, kana kwaiva munhu kana chinhu (가요, 와요, 있어요).
n-k-l1c-02.s.s3.prompt: Zvino nyora patsva MUTSARA WESE wakanga une kukanganisa, nemazvo. Nyora mitsara yakagadziriswa muchiKorea uye uchengete zviito.

n-k-l1c-03.topic: Nguva nenzvimbo: ndiani ari kupi, rinhi

n-k-l1c-04.material: Mutambo wemakadhi emitsara. Mazwi: 동생 = munin'ina, 공원 = paki, 빵 = chingwa, 카페 = cafe, 식당 = resitorendi, 시장 = musika, 사요 = anotenga, 읽어요 = anoverenga.

n-k-l1c-04.s.s1.r.a: Chinhu (빵) hachina 을/를. ChiKorea chinotaurwa kazhinji chinochisiya, asi mitemo yekadhi inochida.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s1.r.b: Maparticle akachinjana: izvi zvinoti chingwa chinodya munin'ina.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s1.r.d: 공원에 inoratidza nzvimbo yaunoenda; nzvimbo yaunodya, kadhi rinoda 에서.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s1.explain: c ne e zvine zvikamu zvese zvina: muiti 동생이, nzvimbo 공원에서, chinhu 빵을, chiito 먹어요 pakupera. Nhevedzano yezvikamu zvepakati inogona kuchinja; chiito chinoramba chiri chekupedzisira.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira kadhi rako. Nyora mutsara mumwe wechiKorea nezvemunhu (iwe, shamwari, mhuri yako) anodya kana kunwa chimwe chinhu panzvimbo. Tevedza mitemo yese mina, uye upedzise chiito ne -아요/어요.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza zvikamu zvitatu kutanga: ndiani, kupi, chii.
n-k-l1c-04.s.s2.hint.1: Wedzera maparticle rimwe nerimwe, wobva waisa chiito pakupera uye ukape -아요/어요.

n-k-l1c-04.s.s3.prompt: Mudzidzi mukirasi yako akagadzira makadhi mana. Kadhi rimwe rine maparticle asina kururama, saka mabasa akavhiringidzika. Rigadzire.

n-k-l1c-05.title: Ndiani anodya keke? Chati chinoramba chichichinja

n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.prompt: Verenga hurukuro yemhuri chikamu chimwe panguva. Mazwi: 만들어요 = anogadzira, 좋아해요 = anoda, 먹어요 = anodya, 안 + chiito = haadi. Sarudza kuverenga kunokodzera zvawaverenga kusvika zvino.

n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Hapana muchisikwa mutsara chinotaura 동생 kana vana.

n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.st.2.after: 안 + chiito = haadi. 아빠 haaidyi, 저 anoidya, uye 동생 pamwe anoidya. 엄마 haatauri semudyi.

n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: 저는 케이크를 먹어요 inoti mutauri anoidya.

n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Mitsara miviri inoti zvakapesana: 아빠 haaidyi uye 저 anoidya.

n-k-l1c-05.s.s1.reflect: Mutsara mutsva wega wakachinja mhinduro. Pakutanga hapana chaiizikanwa nezvemudyi; wobva wavapo mudyi anogoneka; wobva mumwe abviswa. Tarisa kuti chiito chipi chauri kuverenga usati wasarudza kuti ndiani anochiita.

n-k-l1d-02.prereq.2: Unoziva kuverenga kwemuno ne개 (한 개 ... 일곱 개)

n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa mutengo wenhamba yega yega yegimbap nemutengo wegimbap imwe.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.o.a: Gimbap inodhura shoma pachidimbu kana ukatenga zvakawanda: 3 zvinodhura 4,500 won.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.o.b: Gimbap imwe neimwe inodhura 2,000 won, saka gimbap 3 dzinodhura 6,000 won.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.r.b: Rondedzero inoti 세 개: 사천오백 원, saka gimbap 3 dzinodhura 4,500 won, kwete 6,000.

n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.r.d: Rondedzero inoti 두 개: 사천 원, saka gimbap 2 dzinodhura 4,000 won.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s1.explain: Tafura inoratidza mutengo weseti yose: gimbap 1 2,000, gimbap 2 4,000, gimbap 3 4,500, gimbap 4 6,000. Mutengo hausi 2,000 kuwanda nhamba nguva dzose.
n-k-l1d-02.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga mabhasiketi 2 akasiyana anokodzera ZVOSE zviri mumashoko. g = nhamba yegimbap, b = nhamba yechingwa (mabhodhoro 2 emvura atokonzerwa).

n-k-l1a-01.title: Junho anoverenga marebhulu echitoro nenzwi
n-k-l1a-01.goal: Tsvaga kuverenga murondedzero yemumwe wekirasi kunosanganisa mavhawero akaenzana nekutarisa, tumidza rudzi rwekukanganisa, uye unyore kuverenga kwakarurama.
n-k-l1a-01.material: Junho ari kudzidza Hangul. Anoverenga marebhulu matanhatu echitoro nenzwi uye anonyora kuverenga kwake padivi pemazwi. Hunhu hwemavara hwekushandisa: ㅏ = a, ㅓ = eo (sa 'uh'), ㅗ = o, ㅜ = u, ㅣ = i, ㅡ = eu; ㄱ = g, ㄴ = n, ㄷ = d, ㅁ = m, ㅂ = b, ㄹ = r/l; bhuroko rinotanga ne ㅇ rinotanga nenzwi remuvhawero. Kuverenga kwakawanda kwaJunho hakururami.
n-k-l1a-01.prereq.0: Unoziva mavara eHangul nenzwi ayo ekutanga
n-k-l1a-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe apo kuverenga kwaJunho kusingaenderani neHangul. (Mutsara unopfuura mumwe hauna kururama.)
n-k-l1a-01.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga bhuroko rega rega iwe pachako uchishandisa hunhu hwemavara, wobva waenzanisa kuverenga kwako nekwaJunho.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa muvhawero mubhuroko rega rega nemuvhawero mukuverenga kwake, bhuroko rimwe panguva.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s1.explain: Mitsara 2 ne4 haina kururama. 구두 ine ㅜ (u), saka ndi gu-du, kwete go-du. 거미 ine ㅓ (eo), saka ndi geo-mi, kwete ga-mi. Mitsara mina yasara inoenderana.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.hint.0: Rondedzera mavara akachinja pakati peHangul nekuverenga kwaJunho mumutsara wega wega usina kururama.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kuchinja kuri muconsonant, muvhawero, kana munhevedzano yemabhuroko here?
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.o.a: Akasanganisa maconsonant maviri akafanana (semuenzaniso ㄱ ne ㅋ).
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.r.a: Maconsonant ari mumitsara isina kururama (ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ) akaverengwa zvakarurama (g, d, m). Kuchinja kuri muvhawero.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.o.b: Akasanganisa mavhawero akaenzana nekutarisa: mutsetse uri kune rimwe divi kana rimwe kumagumo (ㅜ/ㅗ, ㅓ/ㅏ).
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.o.c: Akaverenga mabhuroko munhevedzano isina kururama, bhuroko rekupedzisira kutanga.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.r.c: Kuverenga kwose kunochengeta nhevedzano yemabhuroko (go-du ine nhevedzano imwe chete ne gu-du). Inongova nzwi remuvhawero rakachinja.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.o.d: Akanganwa kuti ㅇ pakutanga kwebhuroko haina nzwi.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.r.d: Mazwi ane ㅇ yekutanga (우유) akaverengwa zvakarurama, uye mitsara isina kururama haina ㅇ yekutanga.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s2.explain: Mumitsara yose miviri isina kururama muvhawero wakachinja: ㅜ yakava o, uye ㅓ yakava a. Mapeya aya anosiyana nenzvimbo chete yemutsetse mupfupi. Mavhawero akaenzana nekutarisa kukanganisa kwekutanga kwakajairika.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.prompt: Nyora kuverenga kwakarurama kwemazwi maviri asina kururama nemavara eLatin (sa 'na-mu'), wobva wawedzera zano rimwe pfupi rinobatsira Junho kusiyanisa mavhawero akaenzana nekutarisa.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.hint.0: Enzanisa kuverenga kwako pachako kwemazwi maviri asina kururama bhuroko nebhuroko.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.hint.1: Zano rinofanira kutaura kwakaiswa mutsetse mupfupi (pamusoro, pasi, kuruboshwe kana kurudyi rwemutsetse murefu).
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kuverenga kwega kwega kwakaitwa nehunhu hwemavara hwakapiwa chete here?
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Zano rangu rinotaura kwakaiswa mutsetse wemuvhawero wega wega here?
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.model.0: gu-du ne geo-mi. Zano: ㅜ ine mutsetse wayo pazasi pemutsetse, ㅗ yainawo pamusoro.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.model.1: 구두 = gudu, 거미 = geomi. Zano: pa ㅓ mutsetse mupfupi unoratidza kuruboshwe, pa ㅏ uri kurudyi.
n-k-l1a-01.s.s3.model.2: gu-du / geo-mi. Yeuka: muvhawero 'wekumusoro' ㅗ ndi o, muvhawero 'wepasi' ㅜ ndi u.

n-k-l1a-02.title: Mavara madiki epazasi anongova mushonga here?
n-k-l1a-02.topic: Kuverenga Hangul: consonant yekupedzisira (받침) inochinja izwi
n-k-l1a-02.goal: Tonga chirevo chemumwe wekirasi nezveconsonant yekupedzisira (받침) nehumbowo kubva patagi yemutengo nekubhadhara, uye uchitsanangure nemashoko ako pachako.
n-k-l1a-02.material: Pachitsuwa chemusika, Jiwoo naHajun vanotarisa tagi yemutengo wepaketi remaapuro. Nhamba dzaunoda: 이 = 2, 삼 = 3, 사 = 4, 오 = 5, 천 = 1,000 (saka 이천 원 = 2,000 won). Jiwoo anoverenga tagi se삼천 원. Hajun anoti: 'Mavara madiki epazasi ebhuroko mushonga chete, saka 삼 ne사 zvakafanana uye ndinoverenga 사천 원.'
n-k-l1a-02.thinking.1: Kuona kuti chidimbu chidiki chinogona kuchinja zvirevo
n-k-l1a-02.prereq.0: Unogona kuverenga mabhuroko eHangul ane consonant yekupedzisira
n-k-l1a-02.prereq.1: Unoziva nhamba 이, 삼, 사, 오 ne천
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.prompt: Edza mutemo waHajun pandorondedzero yenhamba: mutemo unoti chii nezvemabhuroko 삼 ne사, uye unoenderana nerondedzero here?
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.hint.0: Vhara vara repazasi re삼 nemunwe wako. Bhuroko ripi rinosara?
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa bhuroko iroro nerondedzero yenhamba. Mutemo wacho wungapabe nhamba mbiri dzakasiyana here?
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.o.a: Aizova izwi rimwe chete, uye izvo zvinoenderana nerondedzero: 삼 = 3 ne사 = 3.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.r.a: Rondedzero haitauri izvozvo. Inopa 삼 = 3 ne사 = 4, nhamba mbiri dzakasiyana.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.o.b: Aizoratidzika akasiyana mukunyora nemaoko, asi mukudhindwa ibhuroko rimwe chete.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.r.b: Mukudhindwa zvakare, 삼 ne사 mabhuroko maviri akasiyana: rimwe rine ㅁ pazasi uye rimwe risina chinhu.
n-k-l1a-02.s.s1.o.c: Aizova izwi rimwe chete pasi pemutemo, asi rondedzero inopa 삼 = 3 ne사 = 4, saka mutemo unotadza.

n-k-l1b-04.title: Mina anoverenga mitengo
n-k-l1b-04.topic: Hangul muhupenyu chaihwo: bhodhi remenyu nemanotsi aro
n-k-l1b-04.goal: Tonga chirevo cheshamwari yake nebhodhi rose remenyu, tsvaga mutsetse wekufunga kwake unokundikana, uye utsanangure uchishandisa chinyorwa chiri pasi pemenyu.
n-k-l1b-04.material:
Iwe naMina muri kushopu yezvekudya zvidiki. Mina anotarisa bhodhi remenyu uye anokutumira meseji. Bhodhi:

[분식집 메뉴]
김밥 3,000원
라면 4,000원
떡볶이 4,000원
